title: Recovery 4a - normal-boot listen with the adapter on this PC
source: Own photos, raptox's unit: stitched microscope mosaic of 2026-11-03 (~229 px/mm)
caption: Strap off: nothing on the strap pads. The adapter's RXD through 4.7 kΩ on the chip's TX hole, its GND on hole 3; its TXD connected to nothing. Supply on JP5, limit 100 mA, then 500 mA.

callouts.label: JP5 pin 1 (square), 5 V in
callouts.note: The square pad, '1' printed left of it; VIN = J8 pins 1-6 = U17's input (J-077, J-080). Bench supply + at 5.0 V, OVP 6 V, current limit 100 mA. Never above 6 V. Then 500 mA.

callouts.label: JP5 pin 2, GND
callouts.note: The round pad above pin 1, '2' printed left of it; GND, the same net as U15 pin 4 (J-080).

callouts.label: J29 hole 1: assumed chip TX
callouts.note: The bottom hole, by the printed dot (J-112). Assumed the CC3220's TX here; chapter 1 decides. If chapter 1 found hole 2 to be TX, swap the two signal probes. The adapter's RXD through 4.7 kΩ.

callouts.label: J29 hole 2: not used now
callouts.note: The middle hole (J-112). Nothing on it in this step (assumed the CC3220's RX; chapter 1 decides). If chapter 1 found this hole to be TX, the RXD probe goes here instead.

callouts.label: J29 hole 3, GND
callouts.note: The top hole, '3' printed above it: GND (J-112). To the adapter's GND.

callouts.label: strap pads: nothing connected
callouts.note: The three tinned strap pads right of J14, X4 at the top (J-098): X4 = SOP0, X5 = SOP1, X6 = SOP2 (measured with the beeper, 2026-11-05). Normal boot: all three stay free.

callouts.label: J8: cable OUT
callouts.note: The FFC stays out of J8 in every bench session: the board gets its power on JP5 only (J-077).
